reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend helper with holidays and reuses RSchedule/recurConfigToRSchedule, but the daily-skip rule is not folded into a shared helper and callers re-test weekend/holiday with d.isWeekend || isHoliday instead of the (private) isNonWorkingDay.

duplication.why: The daily-skip-or-move flatMap block is copied almost verbatim between getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange, and the daily-skip condition is re-expressed a third time (twice) inside getNextDate.

placement.why: Holiday matching and weekend moving sit correctly in shared/schedules.ts, but the per-occurrence 'skip or move' decision is written inline in server/schedules/app.ts handlers instead of the shared schedule module.

scope.why: Edits are all related to the four steps (daily skip, range handler, holidays, MM-DD), with the holidays field plumbed through parseRecurDate and the type.

maintainability.why: The weekend policy now lives in four places with different shapes (getNextDate retry loop, two flatMaps, budget template mover that ignores daily skip), plus a magic take padding and a 370-iteration loop, so the next rule change must be repeated by hand.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts decide daily skip with their own d.isWeekend||isHoliday check instead of a shared helper; budget/schedule-template.ts still applies getDateWithSkippedWeekend to daily schedules, bypassing the daily-skip rule added in getNextDate

disguised_duplication.where: the daily skip/move decision appears as a flatMap in getUpcomingDates, a reshaped flatMap with interval filter in getDatesInRange, and a retry loop plus last-occurrence guard in shared getNextDate

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; getNextDate gains isDaily skip loop and isDaily last-occurrence branch; getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange reimplement the daily rule and schedule-template.ts bypasses it
